verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication SaaS, not a coding agent or browser-automation/testing tool. Having an agent verify its own implementation by navigating an app and capturing before-and-after screenshots is a category error for this product type. Its documented MCP, CLI and skills support lets agents work with Basecamp data, but it does not ship visual self-verification, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
